title: 第523章 你想如何第522章 国运加身
content_zh:
第523章你想如何
而此刻，面对女帝那惊天动地的威势，凌清雪终于收起了之前的轻松之色。
她的目光变得凝重起来，她能感觉到，女帝这次是认真的。
“好一个大乾女帝……”
凌清雪在心中暗暗想道：
“不愧是能坐上皇帝位置的人，能将大乾国运运用到这种程度，说明她已经与这片土地建立了某种深层次的联系。”
“在这种状态下，她的实力，至少能提升三层。”
“而且，在大乾疆域之内，她可以随时调用国运之力补充消耗，几乎等同于拥有无穷无尽的灵力储备。”
“此消彼长之下，若是陷入持久战，对我极为不利。”
“这下，有点棘手了……”
不过，她并没有退缩。
凌清雪一步踏出，伸出右手，五指张开，朝向天空。
“剑来。”
话语落下，仿佛蕴含着某种玄妙的韵律，引动着天地之间的某种力量。
起初，没有任何动静。
所有人都愣住了，不知道她在做什么。
然而，下一刻。
轰隆隆。
大地忽然剧烈震动起来！
远处，青云剑宗后山的方向，一道璀璨的蓝色光柱冲天而起，直插云霄！

那光柱之中，蕴含着一股可怕恐怖剑意，仿佛要将整片天穹都撕裂开来！
紧接着，一道清脆的剑鸣声，从远方传来。
那剑鸣声，初始还很微弱，仿佛从极远的地方传来。
但很快，那剑鸣声越来越响亮，越来越清晰，仿佛有一柄绝世神兵，正在以一种不可思议的速度，向这边飞来！
嗖。
一道蓝色的流光，从天际划过，速度快到极致，仿佛一道流星坠落！
那流光所过之处，空气都被撕裂开来，留下一道长长的白色痕迹！
眨眼之间，那蓝色流光便已飞到剑冢外，悬浮在凌清雪身前！
光芒散去，露出一柄通体湛蓝的长剑，仿佛是由最纯净的深海玄冰打造而成。
整柄剑悬浮在空中，仿佛那不是一柄剑，而是一头沉睡的远古凶兽，随时都可能苏醒过来，吞噬一切！
“那是什么剑？！”
有人惊呼出声，声音中满是震惊：
“好恐怖的剑意！仅仅是看着它，我就感觉眼睛要被刺瞎了！”
“这剑绝对不简单，绝对不是天阶灵器能比的！”
content_en:
Chapter 523 What do you want?
But at this moment, facing the earth-shattering power of the empress, Ling Qingxue finally put away her previous relaxed look.
Her eyes became serious, and she could feel that the empress was serious this time.
"What a great queen..."
Ling Qingxue secretly thought in her heart:
"She is worthy of being in the position of emperor. To be able to use Daqian's national destiny to this extent shows that she has established some deep connection with this land."
"In this state, her strength can be improved by at least three levels."
"Moreover, within the territory of Daqian, she can call on the power of national destiny to replenish consumption at any time, which is almost equivalent to having endless spiritual power reserves."
"With this situation ebbing and flowing, if we fall into a protracted war, it will be extremely detrimental to me."
"This time, it's a bit tricky..."
However, she didn't back down.
Ling Qingxue took a step forward, stretched out her right hand, and opened her fingers toward the sky.
"Here comes the sword."
The words fell, as if they contained some mysterious rhythm, arousing some kind of power between heaven and earth.
At first, there was no movement.
Everyone was stunned, not knowing what she was doing.
However, the next moment.
Rumble.
The ground suddenly shook violently!
In the distance, in the direction of the back mountain of Qingyun Sword Sect, a bright blue beam of light soared into the sky and penetrated into the sky!
There was a terrifying and terrifying sword intent in that pillar of light, as if it was going to tear the entire sky apart!
Immediately afterwards, a crisp sword sound came from the distance.
The sound of the sword was very weak at first, as if coming from a very far away place.
But soon, the sound of the sword became louder and clearer, as if a peerless magic weapon was flying towards this side at an incredible speed!
Whoosh.
A stream of blue light streaked across the sky at extremely fast speeds, as if a meteor was falling!
Wherever the stream of light passed, the air was torn apart, leaving a long white trail!
In the blink of an eye, the blue stream of light flew outside the sword tomb and floated in front of Ling Qingxue!
The light dissipated, revealing a blue long sword that seemed to be made of the purest deep sea ice.
The entire sword is suspended in the air, as if it is not a sword, but a sleeping ancient beast that may wake up at any time and devour everything!
"What kind of sword is that?!"
Someone exclaimed, his voice full of shock:
"What a terrifying sword intent! Just looking at it, I feel like my eyes are going to be stabbed blind!"
"This sword is definitely not simple, and it is definitely not comparable to a heaven-level spiritual weapon!"
